attempts.why: Change descendant selector to direct child so nested article cards inside modal do not inherit modal container styles.

selfVerify.reason: Nested <article> renders as distinct card with its own padding/shadow/radius and does not inherit outer modal article container styles (no duplicated modal positioning/border/large shadow), indicating direct-child selector is now used.

pick.suspected: Modal container selector targets descendant `article` (e.g. `dialog article`) instead of direct child `dialog > article`, so the nested card <article> inside the modal <article> incorrectly inherits modal positioning/shadow/border/padding styles.
